map-dimensions.description: The total number of tiles in the map grid. Resize Map - Applies the new dimensions to the map. Warning: Shrinking the map may erase existing tiles.

tile-types.description: The type of terrain surface selected for drawing on the map.

brush-settings.description: The shape and diameter of the brush size used for drawing tiles.

map-title.description: The display name of the level.

starting-coins.description: The amount of gold the player starts with.

starting-lifes.description: The amount of lives the player starts with.

extra-lifes.description: A toggle to enable or disable the 'Extra Life' purchase button.

extra-lifes-prices.description: The price progression for extra lives. The last price will repeat indefinitely. Leave blank for default settings.

description-text.description: A brief overview or lore of the map shown in the menu as description.

tile-size.description: The fixed pixel dimensions of each map tile. This value is read-only.

difficulty.description: The challenge level of the map, usually represented by ⭐.

price.description: The gold cost required to build the tower.

damage.description: The amount of health removed from an enemy with each hit.

fire-rate.description: The interval between shots measured in milliseconds (e.g., 400ms).

range.description: The detection radius where the tower first targets an enemy.

speed.description: The travel velocity of the tower's projectiles.

sell-price.description: The amount of gold returned when the tower is sold.

color.description: The color of the flags on the tower's building.

enemy-type.description: Specifies which enemy type triggers the shake effect.

shake-duration.description: How long the shake effect lasts once activated.

shake-intensity.description: The strength of the shake effect during its duration.

type.description: Identifies the enemy type. Certain game effects may interact with specific types.

count.description: The number of enemies in this spawn group.

health.description: The health value of each individual enemy in this group.

speed.description: The movement speed of enemies in this group.

path.description: The route enemies follow. Example: S1→E1 means they move from Start 1 to Exit 1.

interval.description: The time interval between spawning each enemy in the group.

first-delay.description: The delay before the first enemy of this group appears.

coin-reward.description: The amount of gold awarded for defeating one enemy from this group.
